# Hardware: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49

The "B" listing is the same board in Case B with a Li-Po battery. This page is generated from `device/device.json` (sha256 `ad8ce7365bb0`), the kit's single source of board facts. Every fact has a source and a verification date.

## Board

| Fact | Value | Source | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|
| SoC | ESP32-S3R8, 240 MHz, 8 MB PSRAM, 16 MB flash | Waveshare wiki (ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49); Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet for the CPU clock | 2026-10-11 |
| Main I2C bus | SDA GPIO47, SCL GPIO48. The main bus carries the expander, the codec, the microphone ADC, the RTC and the IMU. Touch has its own bus. | task 0.3, spikes/hw: pins from the Waveshare demo (facts only); a scan of the bus found ES8311 0x18, TCA9554 0x20, ES7210 0x40, PCF85063 0x51 and QMI8658 0x6B | 2026-10-18 |
| I/O expander | TCA9554 at 0x20, INT to GPIO42: P0 TP_INT, P1 BL_EN, P2 IMU_INT1, P3 IMU_INT2, P4 RTC_INT, P5 LCD_TE, P6 SYS_EN, P7 NS_MODE | task 0.3, spikes/hw: the schematic (Waveshare wiki) names each port pin and routes the expander's INT to GPIO42; the bus scan found the chip at 0x20; P0 (touch interrupt), P5 (TE) and P7 (amplifier) were confirmed on the board | 2026-10-18 |
| Display | AXS15231B over QSPI, panel 172 × 640, landscape 640 × 172, RGB565 (byte-swapped), 3.49-inch (190 ppi, 7.5 px/mm, about 86 × 23 mm). Full-frame writes only; no hardware rotation. | Waveshare wiki and demo repo (facts only; the repo has no licence). Full-frame-only and no hardware rotation: atomic14's AXS15231B write-up (community). PPI and mm computed from the 3.49-inch diagonal and 172x640. | 2026-10-11 |
| Case | Case B: 98.5 × 34.8 × 22.8 mm | Waveshare wiki (Case B dimensions); the owner confirmed the board is in Case B | 2026-10-11 |
| Touch | capacitive, AXS15231B (integrated touch), I2C 0x3B, 1 point, never a wake source. Interrupt: V1 none, V2 TCA9554 P0 (unusable: the expander's interrupt on GPIO42 fires on every input change, including TE on P5). | Waveshare wiki and demo repo (facts only); the controller reports up to two points (multi_point), and the kit uses the first | 2026-10-11 |
| Buttons | BOOT = GPIO0 (active low); PWR = GPIO16 (active low). Held through a reset, BOOT enters the ROM download mode, so never design a boot-time BOOT combination. | Waveshare wiki and demo repo (facts only); Espressif ESP32-S3 boot-mode strapping for GPIO0 | 2026-10-11 |
| Power | Hold: TCA9554 P6. On battery the board stays on only while P6 is asserted; releasing it powers the board off. Battery: Li-Po 3.7 V on ADC1_CH3 through a ×3 divider. | Waveshare wiki and demo repo (facts only); Case B battery confirmed by the owner | 2026-10-11 |
| Audio | ES8311 DAC, ES7210 ADC, 2 microphones, MX1.25 speaker header (a buyer review says a speaker is included) | Waveshare wiki (facts only) | 2026-10-11 |
| Codec wiring | ES8311 at 0x18 on the main I2C bus; I2S MCLK GPIO7, BCLK GPIO15, WS GPIO46, DOUT GPIO45 | task 0.3, spikes/hw: the I2S pins from the schematic and Waveshare's codec configuration (facts only); the bus scan found the codec at 0x18, and the tones played through these pins were heard (owner) | 2026-10-18 |
| RTC | PCF85063 at 0x51 | Waveshare wiki (facts only) | 2026-10-11 |
| IMU | QMI8658 at 0x6B | Waveshare wiki (facts only) | 2026-10-11 |
| Wi-Fi | 2.4 GHz. The ESP32-S3 has no 5 GHz radio. A phone hotspot must offer 2.4 GHz (iPhone: Maximize Compatibility). | Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet | 2026-10-11 |

## Measured values

| Fact | Value | Source | Verified |
|---|---|---|---|
| Full-frame flush time | 13 ms | task 0.3, spikes/hw: mean of 100 full-frame flushes, 13.0 ms (p95 13.2), QSPI at 40 MHz, rotating 64-row strips into two internal bounce buffers while the previous strip is sent. Rotating the whole frame first (the kit's lcd349__rotate_frame, PSRAM to PSRAM) took 75.7 ms, so the hardware backend must rotate in strips. | 2026-10-18 |
| Panel refresh rate | 61 Hz | task 0.3, spikes/hw: the panel's TE signal (expander P5) pulses every 16.41 ms (15-18 ms) over 1,218 pulses (spikes/hw/logs/expander-and-tone.log) | 2026-10-18 |
| Touch sampling period | 30 ms | task 0.3, spikes/hw: a finger held still, 4 s per period. The controller makes a new report about every 16.8 ms and answers 'no new data' (0x30 in every byte) between reports, which reads like a lift: 5 ms 224 false lifts, 10 ms 147, 15 ms 19, 20 ms and 30 ms none. 30 ms leaves headroom for scheduling jitter. | 2026-10-18 |
| Display rotation | cw90 | task 0.3, spikes/hw: with cw90 the image is upright when the edge with the buttons is at the top (owner) | 2026-10-18 |
| Backlight polarity | active low | task 0.3, spikes/hw: the Waveshare demo drives duty 0 for full brightness (facts only); confirmed on the board with an inverted 50 kHz PWM output | 2026-10-18 |

## Kit behaviour

These are lcd349-kit choices, not board facts (lcd349-kit design.md (kit behaviour, not a board fact)): backlight 80 % at start, button debounce 10 ms, `power_off` reports USB after 1000 ms, up to 4 saved Wi-Fi networks, a scan every 60 s while disconnected, audio at 16000 Hz.
